# Installing the Symfony skill library

Everything under `dist/` is generated from `content/` by `bun run build`.
Never edit it: run the build and commit the result instead.

| Harness | Mechanism | Where it goes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | plugin marketplace | dev-toolings/superpowers-symfony |
| Codex CLI | AGENTS.md + prompts | /path/to/your/project/ |
| Grok Build | AGENTS.md + .agents/ | /path/to/your/project/ |
| OpenCode | native skills + agents | .opencode/skills |
| Cursor | rules | .cursor/rules/ |
| Windsurf | rules | .windsurf/rules/ |
| GitHub Copilot | instructions + custom agents | .github/ |
| Gemini CLI | GEMINI.md + commands | /path/to/your/project/ |
| aider | conventions | /path/to/your/project/ |
| Anything else | manual | /path/to/your/project/ |

### Claude Code

```bash
/plugin marketplace add dev-toolings/superpowers-symfony
/plugin install superpowers-symfony@superpowers-symfony
```

Reads content/ directly through the component paths in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. Nothing is generated for it.

### Codex CLI

```bash
cp AGENTS.md /path/to/your/project/
cp dist/codex/prompts/*.md ~/.codex/prompts/
```

### Grok Build

```bash
cp AGENTS.md /path/to/your/project/
mkdir -p .agents && ln -s "$PWD/content/skills" .agents/skills
cp -R dist/agents/commands .agents/commands
```

Grok Build scans `.agents/skills/` and `.agents/commands/` from the cwd up to the repo root, so the skills need no conversion. It follows a symlink, so one link covers all 44.

**Trust the folder first.** Grok loads no project instructions and no project skills until the directory is trusted — `grok inspect` reports `Project trusted: no` and silently lists neither your AGENTS.md nor your skills. Run `grok` once in the project and accept the trust prompt, then verify with `grok inspect`.

### OpenCode

```bash
mkdir -p .opencode && ln -s "$PWD/content/skills" .opencode/skills
cp -R dist/opencode/agent .opencode/agent
```

OpenCode reads the SKILL.md layout as-is; only the agents are translated.

### Cursor

```bash
mkdir -p .cursor/rules && cp dist/cursor/rules/*.mdc .cursor/rules/
```

### Windsurf

```bash
mkdir -p .windsurf/rules && cp dist/windsurf/rules/*.md .windsurf/rules/
```

### GitHub Copilot

```bash
mkdir -p .github && cp dist/copilot/copilot-instructions.md .github/
mkdir -p .github/instructions && cp dist/copilot/instructions/*.md .github/instructions/
mkdir -p .github/agents && cp dist/copilot/agents/*.agent.md .github/agents/
```

Prompt files are deprecated for the Agent Host and are deliberately not generated.

### Gemini CLI

```bash
cp dist/gemini/GEMINI.md /path/to/your/project/
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/commands && cp -R dist/gemini/commands/symfony ~/.gemini/commands/
```

### aider

```bash
cp dist/aider/CONVENTIONS.md AGENTS.md /path/to/your/project/
cp dist/aider/.aider.conf.yml /path/to/your/project/
```

### Anything else

```bash
cp AGENTS.md /path/to/your/project/
```

Point the agent at AGENTS.md; it routes to the right `content/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.

## Using it by hand

The library is plain Markdown. Open `AGENTS.md`, find the skill that matches
the task, and read `content/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. No tooling required.
